name: notebook-discover
description: Rank source candidates found by existing web/search tools and import saved local candidates into notebook sources.

tools.name: discover_sources
tools.description: Rank source candidates for a topic and save them under notebook-outputs/discovered-sources/. This tool does not perform network access.

tools.name: import_discovered_sources
tools.description: Import local candidate files into notebook sources. Candidate objects must include a workspace-relative path.
